caption: The drawing depicts a wooden chest of drawers with decorative features. The furniture piece consists of two main sections: an upper chest with two drawers and a lower stand featuring a single large drawer. The upper chest is adorned with painted designs, including floral patterns and geometric shapes in red, gold, and green tones. Each drawer has metal pull handles with ornate backplates, and the handles are colored in a gold or brass shade. The whole piece rests on four turned legs connected by wavy stretchers, and the wood is shown in a dark brown color. The background is plain and neutral, and the chest is presented in three-quarter view, showing the front and a portion of one side.
title: Chest
cluster: #12 — Spanish Colonial Art of the Southwest
